title: Splitting Assignments Along a Constraint Scope
statement: Let $V$ and $D$ be sets, let $\Psi$ be a constraint template on $D$, and let $c$ be a constraint on $V$ with predicate $p$ and an injective scope map from the predicate’s coordinate set into $V$. Every assignment $V\to D$ is equivalently specified by its values on the ordered variables in the scope and its values on the variables outside the scope; thus there is a bijection between assignments $V\to D$ and pairs consisting of an assignment to the coordinates of $p$ and an assignment to the variables outside the scope.
hypotheses_covered: The scope is an injective map from the coordinates of the selected predicate into $V$
